description: Vision-Driven Automated Mobile Testing Framework for Android & Flutter inspired by Ian Fleming's Q
author: Emanuele Coltro
features: 2-Pass Vision Grounding (Coarse + Fine Bounding Box Zoom Crop)
Action-Level Fast-Path Macro Recording & Replay (pHash screen state matching)
Meta-Suite Manifest YAML support with nested scenarios
Configurable continue_on_failure flow control at step, scenario, and suite levels
Visual Assertion Validation with auto-saved final screenshot
Deep Root Cause Analysis cards in interactive single & master HTML reports
Interactive ADB Device Selection Menu with automatic preference saving
